aboutMe.subtitle: Hello!
aboutMe.content: Nice to meet you! I'm Fabian Stiven Valencia Cordoba

aboutMe.subtitle: About Me
aboutMe.content: I'm a Professor, PhD Student, Systems Engineer, Information Systems Technologist, 3D Modeler, UX/UI Designer, and Researcher

aboutMe.subtitle: Passion
aboutMe.content: I'm passionate about Web 3D, User Experience and Usability, Accessibility, Extended Reality, 3D Modeling, Metaverses, and Game Development

aboutMe.subtitle: Experience
aboutMe.content: Since 2024, I have been a Part-time Professor in the Systems Engineering and Software Development Technology programs at Universidad del Valle

aboutMe.subtitle: Experience
aboutMe.content: I'm a professor in the Camaleón Research Group, focusing on topics related to Web 3D, UX/UI, and 3D Modeling

aboutMe.subtitle: Experience
aboutMe.content: I was a Service Technician at Universidad del Valle to provide technical support for the specialized training diploma 'Specialized training, good practices in the use of Science, Technology, and Innovation and Technological Transfer'

aboutMe.subtitle: Experience
aboutMe.content: I was a Support Professional in the PMO coordination of the project 'Strengthening business competitiveness through the use of STI as a cross-cutting development tool in the Valle del Cauca department'
